items.text: Every problem solved with recursion (loops only for bookkeeping)
items.notes: Component iteration in HasCycle is also recursive.

items.text: Data model per Answer/Question/Questionnaire interfaces, snake_case JSON
P1 findLongestQuestionPath returns length, question_ids, answer_path
items.notes: length equals question_ids length by construction.

items.text: P1 longest path = question + longest of successor paths (recursive)
P1 handles multi-answer and unconditional-next questions
P1 tracks answer IDs; only radio/select contribute
P1 cycle guard with set of questions on current path
P1/P2 cache best result per question id
items.notes: Searched FindBestPath for a memo dictionary; none (memo only in P3).

items.text: P2 shortest path, recursive, considering all branches
P2 returns any valid shortest path; cycle guard
P3 recursive count; null next counts as one path
P3 each answer counted as own branch
P3 detect cycle and return -1
items.notes: Checks whole graph, matching 'questionnaire contains a cycle'.

items.text: P4 recursion with depth tracking and min-depth update rule
P4 empty array for END answer or unknown IDs
P4 output fields, unique entries, sorted by min_depth then id
P5 equal-likelihood recursive propagation accumulating across branches
items.notes: Accumulates into map keyed by id.

items.text: P5 text/checkbox forwards full probability; first question 1.0/1.0
P5 conditional expected_position; unreachable -> 0/0
P5 round to 4 decimals; sort probability desc then id

findings.title: No automated tests
findings.evidence: 0 test files; results only printed to console.
findings.impact: Correctness rests on visual check of one example; edge cases untested.
findings.recommendation: Add an xUnit project covering the example, cycles, unknown IDs and unreachable questions.

findings.title: Empty README and poor repo hygiene
findings.evidence: README has only a title; IDE files committed; commit messages like '//' and 'detyra'.
findings.impact: Unclear where each task lives and how to run it.
findings.recommendation: Document tasks and dotnet run; move .gitignore to root and remove .vs/; descriptive commits.

findings.title: Whole solution in one file with misleading naming
findings.evidence: Data, models, algorithms and runner in one file; class named Program; C# code in folder java2.
findings.impact: Harder to read, reuse and test.
findings.recommendation: Split into Models/Analyzer files, load JSON from a file, rename folders by topic.

findings.title: P1/P2 and P5 enumerate every path
findings.evidence: No per-question cache in FindBestPath; probability walk visits each path (inferred, not measured).
findings.impact: Exponential cost on large DAGs; irrelevant for the brief's dataset.
findings.recommendation: Cache per question id; topological accumulation for P5.
